parent_failure.decision: Retire immediate fade and MSS reclaim. Six of seven main 18 bp-floor trades hit continuation stop, motivating a materially opposite payoff on untouched dates.

dates.calendar_rule: Last Sunday of each 2022 calendar quarter, fixed before source access.

market.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trade archive

signal.event_rearm: BTC displacement decays to 25 percent for ten completed 100 ms states.

payoff.pullback_entry: Residual trades inside 50-75 percent of its initial divergence while one-second original-direction flow remains nonnegative for three completed states.
payoff.reacceleration_entry: After pullback arming, residual recovers to 90 percent and one-second original-direction aggressive-flow alignment reaches 0.50 for three completed states.
payoff.target: Residual expands to 150 percent for ten completed 100 ms states.
payoff.stop: Residual reclaims to 25 percent, follower moves another 50 percent of the initial gap against the continuation, or BTC displacement loses its origin.
payoff.source_boundary: Unresolved positions receive a full stop and retain the slot through the boundary.
payoff.funding_boundary: Crossed funding receives full-stop treatment and fails the unavailable-path gate.

routing.top_trade_removal: Remove largest ten percent positive 12 bp event keys and reroute the full global-slot path.
